title: A fresh sprint reviewer writes its gap list to a report file the orchestrator reads, not only to its session's last message
goal: the kb-sprint skill's review step starts the read-only reviewer with a brief that names a report file in its scratch directory, and the reviewer writes its final gap list there, so the orchestrator reads the report even when the session's last message is a short follow-up (claude -p's result holds only the last turn)

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();i=t.find('## review');s=t[i:i+4000];sys.exit(0 if 'report file' in s or 'report.md' in s else 1)
